name: hasActiveIncidentTicketing
definition: True when the vendor's own incident records show incidents are routed to a connected ticketing (PSA) system.
population: the incident reports the connected managed-detection tenant lists
evidenceRequiredForTrue: At least one incident report that carries a ticket id from the connected ticketing system (proof even on a partial read), or a complete read of at least one report none of which carries one (False). No incident report, an error or refused answer, or a partial read with no ticket id is not measured. Where the MDR's own queue is the ticketing system, an incident routed to an escalation group counts as ticketed.
